title: Free Printables for Teachers: Crosswords, Word Search
description: Free classroom printables: crossword puzzles, word searches, flashcards, bingo cards and name tracing worksheets from your own words. Nothing is uploaded.
intro: Make classroom printables from your own word lists: crossword puzzles with answer keys, word searches in different versions for every student, two-sided flashcards, bingo sets and name tracing sheets. Everything runs in your browser, so nothing leaves your device.
